items.title: Digital Arabic Maqam Archive and open-source MIDI plug-in now available
items.excerpt: Khyam Allami's long-term research project puts hundreds of Arabic tuning systems, ajnas and maqamat into a free, open archive, paired with a free open-source MIDI plug-in (Tanghim) that lets producers work in microtonal, non-Western tunings directly inside their DAW.

items.title: Talk to Spotify: What AI Chatbots Mean for Music Marketing
items.excerpt: Spotify's new 'Talk to Spotify' ChatGPT-style assistant replaces passive algorithmic discovery with interactive, prompt-based listening, shifting how artists and marketers must optimise metadata and off-platform SEO to stay discoverable.

items.title: Lorde Calls Out Spotify's AI 'About the Song' Feature
items.excerpt: Lorde publicly rejected Spotify's AI-generated 'About the Song' descriptions after the feature surfaced inaccurate context on one of her tracks, arguing that reducing a song to an AI-generated meaning at the source limits free interpretation. Spotify removed the text in question.

items.title: Inside LANDR's Fair Trade AI Program for Indie Artists
items.excerpt: LANDR's Fair Trade AI program pairs upfront cash advances with ongoing revenue sharing when it licenses curated music datasets to AI developers, allocating 25% of net resulting revenue to participating indie artists whose work trains the models.
